identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Decouple safe cleanup and migrate legacy terminal receipts

values.task_boundary: Implement and prove the bounded standalone cleanup and legacy compatibility migration surface required by issue #5779.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: cleanup success, skip, or failure cannot change derived terminal truth
AC-2: dirty or unclassified worktrees return cleanup_skipped_dirty with exact paths and are not deleted
AC-3: clean registered worktrees are removed idempotently
AC-4: removing legacy receipts in a fixture does not change derived terminal resolution
AC-5: current v0.91.8 terminal records match the compatibility census without historical rewrites
AC-6: focused tests, strict Clippy, and exact-head review pass
dependencies: Derived terminal resolver and Git-common cache
non_goals: No terminal lifecycle redesign beyond consuming #5778
No deletion of legacy commands in this issue
No forced cleanup or external archive service
